title: Bevel header
description: A frosted white pill fixed at the top centre of the page: a wordmark, two quiet 60%-grey links that darken on hover, and a dark pill download button that swells slightly on hover. On phones it becomes a full-width rounded bar with a menu icon that opens a frosted dropdown.
notes: fixed: it floats over the top of the page; the first section should leave ~90px of room (the bevel hero does)
the phone menu toggle needs JavaScript
